title: Off-target capability tax: cataloguing collateral damage of a single safety steering vector

original_idea.body: Off-target capability tax: run capability probe battery under one safety steering vector to produce a collateral-damage profile. Inference-only.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: collateral-damage profiling clarifies steering trade-offs, but the catastrophic-risk link is indirect (level 3).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Apply vector + run small public benchmark slices; standard tools, motivated beginner feasible (level 5).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (collateral-damage profile), running several benchmark slices adds modest effort (level 4).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly careful eval labs skip, open models and public benchmarks (level 4).

low_compute.reasoning: Inference-only on benchmark subsets, single GPU (level 4).

novelty.reasoning: Capability degradation documented; a standardized multi-capability profile may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Off-target harm noted in literature; a consolidated collateral-damage profile may be open.
